summary.answer: Cited WZ safe-area caller directly constructs this ammo/equipment container. Creates AmmoWidgetWZ, ability-item(unit189) bound to LethalOffhands.0, equipment and attachment quick-access widgets. Equipment filters include only type equipment, equipped0, quickEquip1; attachment filters require type attachment, availableAction!=NONE, notAvailable0, quickEquip1. Both small lists have10 columns and both sizes use WarzoneInventory. Equipment current/mid/top bind WarzoneInventoryGlobal equipment/equipment0/equipment1. Attachment InventoryOpen defaults false, InventoryOpenRightAligned follows quick inventory open, InventoryClosedRightAligned defaults true; inventory/settings/selection/hint/free-slot/input changes reevaluate. list_item_gain_focus sends SendInventoryItemFocusNotify and returns nil (does not claim event consumed). Self HiddenPreference uses weapon/equipment UI preference; Visible requires playerSpawned, not caster, appropriate positive HUD/weapon visibility and absence of demo/hardcore/remote/opaque/flash/scoped/scoreboard/UI/vehicle-hide/infiltration/PC-inventory exclusions. VisibleCodCaster requires caster+inventory profile1, not ended/vehicle-hide/infiltration. VisibleKillcam requires noncaster, no vehicle-hide/infiltration/PC-inventory and killcam bit. Exact guards in trace. State/input/model notifications reevaluate only. Close is registered via CallOriginalSecond to unselected __onClose; optional postload then AddQuickAccessInventoryWidget for equipment slot4 true and attachments slot5 false; return self. No item debit/equip/network operation is proved by these display/filter registrations; source data, settings and callback/lifetime/native gaps remain.
